evidence.title: Assist for Mac — Clipboard, Notes, Focus Timers & Notch Modules

name: Assist
summary: Local-first Mac app for voice-annotated screenshots, capture editing and clipboard history in the notch.
description: A native macOS utility ($20 one-time). Hold Option anywhere to draw over the screen and speak: the annotated screenshot is saved with a local Whisper transcript, ready to paste into Cursor, Claude Code or Codex. Control+Option captures the full display with a quick crop, blur and frame editor. The notch hosts eleven optional modules — clipboard history, file shelf, notes, focus timers, calendar, media controls, system stats, screen time, image conversion, revenue and AI usage.
contains: $20 one-time purchase, one Mac per license, 1.x updates included
macOS 14+; local voice transcription needs Apple silicon
hold Option to draw and dictate; the transcript is attached to the annotated screenshot
Control+Option full-screen capture with crop, blur, padding, rounded corners, shadows and backdrops
clipboard history for text, links and images with filtering and drag-out
eleven notch modules: clipboard, shelf, notes, timers, calendar, media, system, screen time, convert, revenue, AI usage
revenue module reads Stripe/Polar/Dodo keys from the Keychain; AI usage reads local Claude Code and Codex logs
local-first: screenshots, transcripts and history stay on the Mac
